name: LCL 5050
title: Living the Liberal Arts - The Passionate Humanities
description: Integration of the liberal arts into daily life, particularly through immersion in literature and the arts. Topics may include themes such as the pursuit of meaning, identity, mortality, happiness, and community. The course culminates in each student crafting an individual project centered on community involvement, highlighting the idea that personal enrichment through liberal arts engagement can profoundly benefit the broader community.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
